[[The Catacombs]] | merchant = y }} {{Quotation|game|Situated just outside of the [[catacombs]], Ashford Abbey is the resting place for many of [[Ascalon]]'s most distinguished deceased citizens. On nice days, you will find the heads of many noble houses coming to this spot, paying their respects to their ancestors. It's also not uncommon to find a priest or priestess of [[Dwayna]] here, kneeling in supplication before the statue of their goddess.}} [[Ashford Abbey]] is a peaceful haven that caters to the spiritual needs of the village of [[Ashford]]. The abbey is dedicated to [[Dwayna]], the goddess of light and air. ==Getting there== Located just outside the village of [[Ashford]]. Follow the road southwest from Ascalon City. ==Shrines== ;Statue of [[Dwayna]] *At the edge of the main courtyard. ==Quests available== * [[Brother Mhenlo]] ** [[A Monk's Mission]] {{preq|mo|primary=y|secondary=n}} ** [[The Blessings of Balthazar]] {{preq|mo}} ==NPCs== ===Allies=== ====Services==== *{{x}} 2 [[Spence]] ([[merchant]]) ====Other characters==== *{{mo}} 4 [[Brother Mhenlo]] *{{x}} 2 [[Meerak the Scribe]] ==Gallery== File:Ashford Abbey1.jpg|Wide view of the Abbey File:Ashford Abbey2.jpg|Mhenlo and the Statue of Dwayna File:"Mausoleum" concept art.jpg|Concept art of the building near Mhenlo ==Notes== {{gw2w|Abbey Ruins }} [[File:Haunting spectre.jpg|thumb|right|The "Haunting Spectre"|x200px]] *Viewing the abbey from the outside, near the statue of Dwayna, there is a spirit (with the model of a [[Wailing Lord (The Underworld)|Wailing Lord]]). In the Prima guide to Prophecies it is listed as a Haunting Spectre. *After [[the Searing]] Ashford Abbey is renamed [[Sardelac Sanitarium]]. *When viewing Ashford Abbey from outside, you can see various objects and [[Non-player character|NPCs]] you shouldn't be able to see from outside, including the above mentioned Brother Mhenlo, and also [[Wilton Payce]] (who seems to start his walk from somewhere near The Catacombs). *When viewing Ashford Abbey from outside, you can see "Mhenlo" ([[Meerak the Scribe]]) wearing an other Armor as in [[Ashford Abbey]] [[File:Ashford Mhenlo Meerak Tutorial.png|thumb|left|"Mhenlo"(Meerak) With other Armor|x200px]] {{Towns and outposts in pre-Searing Ascalon}}
